Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph NO. 31 23 JOEL l. FERNANDEZ Secretary to the Sanggunian Office of the Sangguniang Panlungsod City of Valencia, Province of Bukidnon Dear Mr. Fernandez: This has reference to your letter dated September 27, 2023 wherein you furnished this Department a copy of Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) Resolution No. 609-2023 entitled "REQUESTING DILG FOR A LEGAL OPINION ON THE COVERAGE OF R.A. NO. 10173 OR THE DATA PRIVACY ACT OF 2012, PERTAINING TO THE REFUSAL OF PROVIDING PUBLIC DOCUMENTS AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OF THE LGU OF VALENCIA CITY, BUKIDNON". Under Sangguniang Panlungsod Resolution No. 609-2023, the ISt WHEREAS clause states that previously, this Department issued DILG Opinion No. 63 S. 2019, stating among others, that the "barangay payroll is regarded as official record/document in the custody of a government agency/official which must be accessible to the public", citing Sec. 7, Art. III of the 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines, Section 5(e) of Republic Act No. 6713 (Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees), sec. 3, Rule IV of the IRR of Republic Act No. 6713, and Sec. 4 of Republic Act No. 10173, otherwise known as the "Data Privacy Act of 2012", as amended. Under this premise arose the request for legal opinion on the following matters: I. Is DILG Opinion No. 63 S. 2019 only limited to barangays or is it also applicable to cities? 2. If there is continued refusal to provide to the Sanggunian, copies of the payroll, what are the legal recourse/s available for the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Valencia City, if any? As to the first query, we answer in the affirmative. DILG Opinion No. 63 S. 2019 also applies to the payroll of the city local government unit. We deem it proper to emphasize that Section 4 of the Data Privacy Act of 2012, as amended, explicitly provides that its provisions are not applicable in the following cases: a) Information about anv individual who is or was an officer or employee of a qovernment institution that relates to the position or functions of the individual, including "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

1) The fact that the individual is or was an officer or employee of the government institution; 2) The title, business address and office telephone number of the individual; 3) The classification. salary range and responsibilities of the position held by the individual; and 4) The name of the individual on a document prepared by the individual in the course of employment with the government; b) Information about an individual who is or was performinq service under contract for a qovernment institution that relates to the services performed, including the terms of the contract, and the name of the individual given in the course of the performance of those services; c) Information relatinq to anv discretionary benefit of a financial nature such as the qrantinq of a license or permit qiven bv the government to an individual. includinq the name of the individual and the exact nature of the benefit, d) xxx xxx xxx [Emphasis and underscoring supplied.] Moreover, as previously emphasized in DILG Opinion No. 63 S. 2019, Section 5(e) of Republic Act No. 6713 (R.A. 6713), all public documents must be made accessible to, and readily available for inspection by, the public within reasonable hours. Correspondingly, Section 3 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of R.A. 6713 provides that every department, office or agency shall provide official information, records or documents to any requesting public, subject to certain exceptions. Hence, DILG Opinion No. 63 S. 2019, which states that "barangay payroll is regarded as official record/document in the custody of a government agency/official which must be accessible to the public" , is also applicable to the payroll of the city local government unit. Accordingly, as to the 2nd query, in case of continued refusal to provide copies of the payroll to the Sanggunian, without any valid justification, it may be a ground for administrative complaints for violating the provisions of R.A. 6713. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BYT AU ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: TTY. JU VIC R.
